name: Clearcutting
description: Deadwood activates a burst of movement, gaining bonus speed. In the card game this is adapted as a row-repositioning ability with a speed/mobility buff.

source.notes: From hon_reborn_slice.json. Self-cast, instant (casttime=0). Applies State_Deadwood_Ability3 for 10s granting treewalking + movespeed 30/45/60/75. No mana cost originally stated as 50. In card game: movement/row relevance only, treewalking has no analogue.

adapted.adaptation_reason: Cooldown: ceil(15s / 5s) = 3 turns. Duration: ceil(10s / 5s) = 2 turns. Movement speed has no direct analogue in the row model; adapted as: free row change this turn + immunity to Slow for duration. The treewalking and tree destruction effects have no card-game mapping and are noted as dropped — balance risk: ability may be weaker than original. Test scenario F.
